critique.evidence: Desktop is polished and distinctive, with strong headline hierarchy, disciplined cyan/red/yellow accents, and cohesive technical styling. Tablet remains composed, but the phylogeny visualization collapses into a less compelling list. Mobile is excessively dense: micro-labels and body copy become difficult to scan, the chart is tiny, long mutation strings wrap awkwardly, and the vaccination cards create a monotonous vertical stack. The actual mobile header also drops the brand name and exposes only a clipped horizontal-nav slice, weakening orientation and finish.
critique.fix: Redesign the mobile composition rather than merely stacking desktop modules: increase minimum text sizes and contrast, simplify chart annotations, truncate or reformat mutation names, compress the vaccination sequence into a clearer stepper, and preserve a recognizable brand/current-section treatment in the header. Give tablet phylogeny a more visual structure instead of a plain list.
